answer: Make every new agent identity pass a dawn probation: at registration it locks a bond that vests only after it completes thirty days of verified, paid work for distinct counterparties. Rewards earned before vesting stay escrowed. A sybil farm can spin up a gale of fake accounts, but each one ties up capital and real labor for a month, and clustered accounts that only trade with each other never vest. Cheap identities become a passing zephyr with no payout.
